channel.title: CellScope Newsletter
channel.description: What shipped, what changed and what we learned across CellScope, FRED and KyCast.

item.title: Issue 5: CS-TOR and the Nov 12 tornadoes
item.description: CS-TOR put its highest tornado chance over Wilmington, DE, and a tornado hit there on Nov 12. What it showed, and what it did not.

item.title: Issue 4: KyCast NEXT 1.2 is live
item.description: KyCast NEXT 1.2 adds HRRR for the first 48 hours and beats NEXT 1 on every held-out benchmark row. Charts, numbers and limits.

item.title: Issue 3: A calibration discovery
item.description: We found something in how KyCast is calibrated that made the models far more trustworthy in testing. The story, without the recipe.

item.title: Issue 2: KyCast NEXT 1 is live
item.description: KyCast NEXT 1, a model built for the next 1-2 days, replaces the 5-day model. Benchmarks against the old model and raw GFS, honest limits, and what NEXT 1.2 changes.

item.title: Issue 1: Hello from CellScope
item.description: FRED V0.2 lite GPU mode, game-day forecasts, FRED Shorts, richer Bluesky cards and the live KyCast viewer.
